description: Change a finished video in plain words, or ask about it. A change asked for in words costs 1 to 2 credits (dry_run: true says the price and sends nothing); exact edits with the direct edit tools and fix_captions are free. It can cut words or moments; restyle captions (size, place, font, colour, on or off, all caps); add titles, text, b-roll, stock or web pictures and clips for what is said, motion graphics from a prompt (counters, lists, charts), sound effects and transitions; set the music and its volume; warm, cool or brighten the look; hold the camera still; mute the camera's sound over chosen seconds; add a shape (16:9, 1:1, 4:5); switch the style (same cut); export and share (if not exported yet it starts the export: ask again); cut a montage to the music; edit gameplay with a facecam; and, for videos made from words, rewrite the script, change the narrator or add a voiceover. A question ("is the title covering his face?") is answered from the real frames and changes nothing. Not by chat yet, so say so: speed changes, splitting or looping, copying a reference's style (copy_style), finding clips in a long video (edit_video with clips). It runs in the background and answers at once with a job_id: check_video with that job_id shows the steps, the editor's reply and anything it could not do. A change that cannot be done leaves the video as it was.

attachments.description: Up to four still images for this change, each with intent reference_only (look at it) or use_in_video (place it): a ChatGPT file, an asset_staging_key from import_asset or an owned asset_id. PNG, JPEG and WebP can be placed; a GIF is read by its first frame.

base_version.description: The version to change, from check_video; the live one when left out.

change.description: The change or question, in the user's words. To add a voiceover, start with 'Narrator: liam\nNarration: <the exact script>' and then anything else to change.

dry_run.description: true: say what the change uses and send nothing.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: Change only this output (a hook, a Short or a format) from check_video.

video_id.description: The video to change, from list_videos or check_video.

voice.description: A new narrator for a video made from words, with a change such as 'Change narrator to Brian. Keep the script and edit.' Leave out when adding a voiceover.

name: revise_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint revise_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Request a video change
